    I hiked up to Bench Lake at Mount Rainier National Park on Tuesday evening. It was fairly cloudy and hazy when I got there, and the lake still had a lot of waves, so I …
    See more
    Mount Rainier rises beyond Bench Lake at sunset, its snow-covered slopes catching a faint pink alpenglow. The mountain is mirrored almost perfectly in the calm water, framed by dark evergreen forest and a soft blue-gray sky. The scene feels peaceful and still.
    CYPBNOXrQ.com
    Steve
    I hiked up to Bench Lake at Mount Rainier National Park on Tuesday evening. It was fairly cloudy and hazy when I got there, and the lake still had a lot of waves, so I was wondering if I had made the trip for nothing. But between 7 and 8 pm as the sun set, the clouds cleared, the wind calmed down, the lake went completely flat. That is when this beautiful reflection of Mount Rainier appeared, with just a slight alpenglow on the mountain and in the water. It was absolutely delightful to watch it all come together.
